method: Current-source review; behavioral evidence in final four-mode matrix and default-parallel workspace logs

review.reason: Array-drop body is dominated by count != 0; subtraction remains checked.
Retains generic pointer arithmetic; no integer wrapping exemption.
Emits Instruction::Add and takes the same checked backend path.
Compound assignment uses ordinary Add/Sub/Mul/Div/Rem/Shl/Shr instructions.
DCE retains integer arithmetic and dependencies even when the result is discarded; float/pointer facts allow dead nontrapping operations to be removed.
Uses checked operations and leaves invalid arithmetic unfurled for runtime trap; no wrapped substitute constant.
Signed/unsigned LLVM overflow intrinsic returns value+flag; guarded trap precedes use; no nsw/nuw as checks.
Zero and signed MIN/-1 guards precede LLVM div/rem, excluding undefined operations.
Count guard precedes shift; unsigned count comparison rejects negative bit patterns and count >= width, including zero lhs; left-shift round trip enforces mathematical representability.
Authenticated CallIntrinsic wrapping operations lower to plain modular add/sub/mul without flags or trap.

Generic enum storage uses configured ABI alignment/size and checked capacity arithmetic; no unchecked Luna source arithmetic exemption. sizeof/alignof use actual mapped target types; unrepresentable array lengths reject before truncation.

skill_impact: none; no conflicting owner/version guidance found in skills
